description:
Mirror of the four Collections of the National Land Survey of Finland Geographic Names Register, taken from the Geographic Names OGC API Features service. The register is the authoritative national record of Finnish place names, carrying each name's spelling, language, officiality and status alongside the place it names, its place type, its elevation and its administrative location. Names are recorded in Finnish, Swedish, Northern Sami, Inari Sami and Skolt Sami. The four Collections give the places themselves, the names attached to them, a flattened variant of those names, and the cartographic map label placements derived from them. Contains data from the National Land Survey of Finland Geographic Names Register, retrieved 9.9.2026.

**Disclaimer:** a demonstration of Portolan as cloud-native infrastructure for disseminating open geodatasets. This catalog republishes data from its original publishers in cloud-native formats such as GeoParquet and PMTiles, with STAC metadata — open, standards-based and freely accessible to everyone. It is not an official service of the original publishers, which remain the authoritative source.
